title: Address to Jordanian Delegation: Heed this Warning!
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh Nazim addresses a royal delegation from Jordan.)
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
They'll fly like dried tree leaves in the air. Out of five only one person will survive. If nuclear reactors erupt all
at once nothing will remain, not even humans, animals, tree, stone or anything… Return to your homes; you
must go inside your houses and stay there! This is an order from the beginning ‘til the end for whoever wishes
to be in safety. If anything happens in the skies, one must go back home, make ablution, pray two prayer
cycles on prayer mat and sit there. Nothing would affect them. However, those who come out, that's it. Those
who stay inside, don’t need to worry, but those outside are prone to danger.
In the world there are six billion (people) that will be killed, because they are not people living or working for
Allah; they are living according to Satan's command. They live a satanic life, and a satanic death as well. They
will not have any comfort here nor in the Hereafter! They have been sentenced to death. There will be
limitless and uncountable deaths. We need your sanctuary, O my Lord! We seek refuge in Allah from bad
consequences. It's difficult, particularly since all the youth are now under the devil's control; I think nothing
will stay the same. Out of a hundred youth, only one will survive.

Not one person will remain among those with shaytanic actions and characteristics; they'll be removed.
Astagfirullah, tawbah yaa Rabbee! God forbid. Forgive me, my Lord!
Parents must observe their children. First instruction/directives coming from our noble masters is to advise
them not to leave anyone outside after sunset; they must return to their homes. Leave the pervading
corruption outside. Fitna is widespread. Take your children inside your homes and stay inside! We have been
instructed to declare to people: take care of your children! Do not leave any of them outside after sunset, and
don’t make excuses that they have tuition, classes or whatever. No, stay at home. Those who keep to their
homes, will be safe and secure.
We cannot give you any guarantee otherwise. You must warn them that no one may stay outside after sunset,
particularly the youth! It is absolutely forbidden as of today, up until the Day of Judgment. Hisham Effendi,
warn them.
A saint with seven heads will not be able to carry any responsibility! Whoever wishes to be safe and sound
should never leave home after sunset. Don't say, “I have class, school, university,” as none of these excuses
will be acceptable. He may be affected by something on his way out or on his way home. This is a general
warning to the people of the world in the east, west, north and south. Starting from today until the Day of
Judgment, it will be forbidden for youth to leave their homes after sunset, except for those heading towards
mosques. If a father takes his children to the mosque for prayer, he can return back home with them.
Secondly, these various advertisements found in the markets, is forbidden for anyone to open/expose such
advertisements from today until the Day of Judgment, or else he will be struck with something bad in this life
and in the Hereafter. (Do you mean, sir, an advertisement contrary to shari`atullah or calling for worldly
things, not for a place or a book?) No need for any advertisements. His Majesty (King `Abdullah II of Jordan)
must also formally forbid people to go out of their houses after `Isha prayer. This should be a martial law. It
is not acceptable for him to license bars, coffee shops, cinemas, theaters. Anything that distracts people from
Allah's command is forbidden.
If such directives are not issued, something will hit/infect the kings as well. The command is finished
(adjudicated). You know that (heavenly) news came on this Friday night, and whoever receives this news and

violates these orders will be struck by something he does not like, God forbid. O Allah! Do not leave us to our
egos, not even for a blink of an eye!
Ladies are not permitted in any form of service departments. (Does this apply before or after the coming of
Mahdi [a]?) After the 'appearance', it will be enforced by the sword! This is a manifestation of sub-dual/
subjugation. They entered into the maze of … They say this is a danger zone! The ant said, "O ants! Return to
your homes!” This declaration is not for the sake of storytelling.
••••••• •••••••• ••• •••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••••• ••• ••••••••••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••••• •••••• •••
•••••••••••
qaalat namlatun yaa ayyuha 'n-namlu 'dkhuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum Sulaymaanu wa
junooduhoo wa hum la yash`uroon. One of the ants said, "O ants! Enter your homes unless Sulayman and his
armies unknowingly trample you. (an-Naml, 27:18)
Those who enters his dwelling place will be safe and secure, as Prophet (s) said that whoever enters Haram
Shareef in Madinah will be safe. Whoever seeks refuge in anyone's home will be safe and whoever enters his
house and closes his door will be safe and secure, as well. It is not acceptable to break into his home by force.
He would be safe and secure.
Saints are managing world matters. This is your limit. If you decide to return/go back, do. Otherwise you will
fall in a limitless pit. If a lady with the most beautiful face digresses from this command and exposes her
beauty in the streets, she will return to her home very ugly so that she never dares to go outside like that
again! Allah Almighty says:
•••••••• ••• •••••••••••• ••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••• •••••••••••••••
Wa qarna fee buyootikunna wa laa tabarrajna tabarruja al-jaahiliyyah. And stay quietly in your houses and
make not a dazzling display like that of the former Times of Ignorance. (Al-Azaab, 33:33)
Is this in Arabic or Turkish, Your Highness, the Princess? Is it mentioned in Arabic in the Holy Qur’an, or
not? What is this? Everyone is hanging around in the streets, in markets, department offices. The one who
permits them to be present in department offices will also be held responsible. This is a directive coming on
this Friday night. (It's a directive, but not an executable command; a legal order has not come yet.) This is a

warning. Be careful. Do not take your head outside. This is a tunnel. You could get hit by something. Close
everything so as not to be struck by anything. This is another directive now. If they listen to what they heard,
it is up to them. If not, they don’t like you, yaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen!
••••••••• ••••• •••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••• •••• ••••••• ••••••••••••••
Wadrib lahum mathalan ashaaba ’l-qaryati idh jaa’ahaa ’l-mursaloon. Set forth to them by way of a parable
the (story of) the Companions of the City. Behold! There came apostles to it. (YaSin, 36:13)
This shows that there must be warners for the ummah, from the beginning to the end! There are those
carrying this responsibility in the east and west. A small one cannot withstand being with a lot of people, but
a poor one like me doesn’t care about anyone, he attacks them!
O Allah! Success comes from Him!
Fatihah.
People follow their kings' religion. If their prince is righteous, his subjects are bound to be just as righteous. If
a king is corrupt, his subjects would be licentious infidels.
Yaa Rabbee! O Allah, grant us your pardon, forgiveness, and mercy. Grant us your forgiveness and rectify us
and reform our lives and the state of Muslims. Grant victory to our sultan, of the humans and jinns,
Sayyidina Mahdi (a). May Allah reveal him, heed our prayer, and hasten his coming! Grant him honor and
glory, and bring him closer, for the sake of the one on whom descended the Opening Chapter of the Qur’an.
Fatihah.
